results.assertion: State transition completes within 1 click/gesture and target view/data updates correctly.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. results.steps: Return empty dataset or no eligible rows.
results.assertion: Fallback/empty message is shown and layout remains stable (no broken placeholders).
results.evidence: The HFB/PA snapshot cards stay stable with missing values: HFB uses fallback placeholders for absent fields and PA renders `-` placeholders directly (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173; frontend/src/features/overview/SnapshotCard.tsx:43,103,166-173).

results.assertion: Error state is user-visible, recoverable on retry, and does not hard-crash route.
results.evidence: Both detail pages surface fetch failures via `ErrorBanner` with retry (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but the KPI summary metric path itself is incomplete.

results.steps: Run representative fixture values through transform/mapping layer.
results.assertion: Scaled and raw fields retain expected precision (sales scaled where applicable, index untouched).
results.evidence: The KPI summary data model is incomplete for the planned module. HFB only hydrates `ytdIndex`/`vsLY` from separate metrics and PA leaves `heroValue` as `-` (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), so the planned multi-metric summary contract is not implemented.

results.steps: Feed out-of-order and duplicate-key fixture records.
results.assertion: Output order and uniqueness follow deterministic rule (documented sort/dedupe behavior).
results.evidence: List ordering/filtering is deterministic in the existing overview/detail components (frontend/src/features/overview/OverviewPage.tsx:311-328,343-383,435-450,518-529,600-605), but the planned `ProductAreaSummaryList` summary dataset/hook named in the plan is not present in this project.

results.steps: Inspect generated request payload and query params for this feature path.
results.assertion: Metric/level/filters are populated exactly as expected for selected hierarchy context.
results.evidence: The plan references `ProductAreaSummaryList`, `usePaSalesPerformanceForHfb`, and a `/metrics` KPI endpoint, but those source files/contracts are not present; backend routes are only `/api` GET endpoints (backend/src/main/java/com/ikea/sp/controller/DashboardController.java:14,29-145).
results.failure_reason: Planned KPI summary hook/service/API not found in project

results.steps: Compare required FE keys against backend response schema fixture.

results.failure_reason: No KPI summary schema drift guard
